Item Class: Misc Map Items
Rarity: Currency
Inscribed Ultimatum
--------
Challenge: Survive
Area Level: 83
Requires Sacrifice: Prospero's Protection
Reward: Grasping Nightshade
--------
Choking Miasma
(A cloud that deals Chaos Damage over Time will follow you)
Razor Dance IV
(Swarms of blades will periodically appear and fly at you, applying Corrupted Blood on Hit and leaving a trail of Blood ground)
Totem of Costly Might
(An invulnerable Totem will appear that imbues both its allies and its enemies with Speed and powerful Physical Damage benefits, but causes enemies to take 10% of their maximum Life and Energy Shield as Physical Damage per second)
Escalating Monster Speed
(Monsters gain 5% increased attack, cast, and movement speed per second they are alive, up to 50%)
Treacherous Auras
(Your Auras that affect Allies also affect Enemies)
Resistant Monsters
(Monsters have +50% to all Resistances)
10% increased Monster Damage
30% more Monster Life
--------
Can be used in a personal map device to open portals to the Trialmaster's Domain and attempt his challenge. Portals will close once the challenge begins. While viewing your Atlas, Right-click this item to pinpoint its location.
